top_signals.title: Russia’s only anti-war party eyes support boost at elections
top_signals.summary: While the liberal Yabloko party is unlikely to win any seats in elections next month, they nonetheless relish the opportunity to push their anti-war message on a national scale.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
